integrity: The proof reconstructs the exact source halfspaces and source-labeled vertices, derives the full vertex-shell spectrum and multiplicities, uses the antipodal pole pair to certify the unique minimum enclosing sphere, and solves the Euclidean ball-clearance inequalities exactly to obtain the inradius and the complete Chebyshev-center phase transition. Finite exact-arithmetic checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the centered cubic isocanted realization with \(d\ge2\), \(\ell>0\), and \(0<a<\ell\). It is not affine invariant and does not cover unequal bounding-box edge lengths, John or Loewner ellipsoids, mean width, or the full pairwise distance distribution. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent observation stated under the newer term isocanted cube.
title: Isocanted cubes have exact vertex shells and a Chebyshev-center phase transition
